content.comment_body: Hello, I am having trouble changing the font size of the analog value in [product_name], which stays the same (around size 12). I tried modifying this in the main HTML file, but my HTML coding skills are limited. I've attached a screenshot of the web interface and included the whole [product_name] file in a zip archive. Is there a simple solution for this?
Could you test the attached file and let me know if it solves the issue?
Thanks for the suggestion, but the numbers in the analog value field are still very small (see attached image).

You can specify the height and size for your input field using the following code: <input class="inputVal" type="text" size="50" value="" style="width:100%;height:100%" height="50">. Add this code to your HTML file for the input field and reload the page.

I forgot to update the main HTML file before my previous response. I made the changes now, but the numbers disappeared from the analog value box. Is it possible to add font-size:24px to the analog value component in the HTM file? Adjusting the size and height doesn't seem to work.
Try adding this to your CSS: input[type='text'] {font-size:24px;}. It might resolve the issue.

This worked! I used the following code, with my additions in bold: <input class="inputVal" type="text" size="5" value="" style="width:100%;height:100%; font-style: normal; font-family: Arial; font-size: 300px;">. Changing the font-size lets me adjust the number size. Now I just need to set a color for the number—I've tried color: rgb(0,0,255) and color: blue, but it didn't have any effect. Thank you for your help so far.
Try using this syntax: <font color="red"> or substitute with your preferred color.
Unfortunately, that approach didn't work. Do you have any other ideas?

Here's another option to try: <input class="inputVal" type="text" size="5" value="" style="width:100%;height:100%; font-style: normal; font-family: Arial; font-size: 300px; text-align: center; color: red">. I've tested it and it works for me. If it doesn't on your end, please upload a screenshot of your HTML page so I can check.

Check out the attached image of the HTML page. The same code (color: xxxx and color: rgb(x,x,x)) is used elsewhere in the HTML but does not work for this particular analog value field. However, changing the background color works fine. Thanks for all the assistance thus far.
It should work as described. Have you tried placing (color: red) as shown in the attachment?

To modify the style of any text, you'll need some basic knowledge of CSS and HTML. Open ‘main.htm’ with an editor or Notepad and look for the row you want to edit. The command ‘style=""’ sets the text properties. You can tweak text size, color, background, and more inside the quotes, separated by semicolons. The color of text is set using color: rgb(r,g,b); where r, g, and b are values from 0 to 255 representing red, green, and blue. Size can be specified with units like 'px' or 'em'. For example: style="width:100%;height:100%;color:rgb(0,0,0);font-size:1.1em;". Note: 1. Incorrect syntax won’t be read by the browser. 2. Any changes to ‘main.htm’ must be made directly on the SD card.
It's still not working. Do you have any idea what might be causing this issue?

Welcome to the forum! "Not working" doesn’t give us much to go on. Several solutions have already been shared in this discussion. Can you specify what you’re trying to achieve and what exactly is failing?

You've probably heard about the upcoming [product_name] release planned for October 2020, along with a new [product_name] version. Here’s a link with details on most of the improvements: [url] The data shown is transmitted by [product_name] to AWS Cloud, and the dashboard was made with [product_name] [version_no]. There’s a page called "New styles" where you can see upcoming improvements for customizing styles. Hope this helps!
I added your suggested lines both in the CSS and in the HTML, and it worked for me. When I added the lines only in HTML and loaded the code into the [product_name], it did not work.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faced challenges when trying to adjust the font size and color of analog value fields in the [product_name] web interface, which required direct editing of HTML and CSS. Font size modifications were eventually successful using CSS, but configuring font color was inconsistent and required trial and error. This points to a lack of intuitive customization options in the interface, making appearance adjustments difficult for users without web development experience.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes for a straightforward way to change the look of analog value fields—including size, font, and color—in the web interface, ideally without needing to understand HTML or CSS.
